defs.def: a place where people live temporarily in tents or temporary buildings 营地

ex.s: select workshops for their parentsB. prepare track topics for the camp

ex.s: In 2015 Stephanie Drewry was looking for a cooking summer camp for her three children.
ex.t: 2015年，斯蒂芬妮·德鲁里为她的三个孩子寻找一个烹饪夏令营。

ex.s: To her dismay, she quickly realized such a camp didn’t exist.
ex.t: 令她沮丧的是，她很快意识到这样的夏令营并不存在。

ex.s: •Full day camp for kids aged 5-13.
ex.t: •面向5-13岁儿童的全日营。

ex.s: All campers should bring their own bagged lunch and snacks.
ex.t: 所有营员应自带午餐和零食。

ex.s: A summer camp notice.
ex.t: 一份夏令营通知。

ex.s: If your child enjoys being in the kitchen, then the culinary camp is definitely the right fit.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子喜欢待在厨房，那么烹饪夏令营一定适合他。

ex.s: This camp takes creative license to an entirely new level.
ex.t: 这个夏令营把创作自由发挥到了一个全新的高度。

ex.s: How many camps does Pali Overnight Adventures offer this summer?
ex.t: Pali Overnight Adventures今年夏天提供多少个营地？

ex.s: What will campers do at the Broadcasting Camp?
ex.t: 营员们会在广播营里做什么？

ex.s: Culinary CampD.
ex.t: 街头艺术营。

ex.s: We were staying at a research camp outside “the polar bear capital of the world”-the town of Churchill in Manitoba，Canada.
ex.t: 我们住在“世界北极熊之都”——加拿大曼尼托巴省丘吉尔镇——外的一个研究营地。

ex.s: The hungry bear followed his nose to our camp，which was surrounded by a high wire fence.
ex.t: 那只饥饿的熊循着气味来到我们的营地，营地四周围着高高的铁丝网。

ex.s: I radioed the camp manager for help.
ex.t: 他告诉我直升机正在路上但要30分钟后才能到达。

ex.s: The camp manager suggested I use pepper spray.
ex.t: 营地管理员建议我使用胡椒喷雾。

ex.s: I find a   47   mountain, with toilets at camps and along the paths.
ex.t: 我发现一座___47___的山，营地和小径旁都有厕所。

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

ex.s: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.
ex.t: 营员们将彼此分享他们多彩的想法和想象力，并合作通过可视化、素描和非传统技法进行创作，画出最酷的壁画，这幅壁画将在公共场合展出供所有人观看。

ex.s: They focus on arriving at the camp in time．
ex.t: B．他们专注于及时到达营地。

ex.s: Scout camp was fun, but not without its challenges!
ex.t: 童子军营地很有趣，但也并非没有挑战！

ex.s: We all grew up hearing  people tell us to “go out and get some fresh air.”    36    According to recent studies，the answer is a big YES，if the air quality in your camping area is good.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 我们都是在听着别人说“出去呼吸点新鲜空气”长大的。    36    根据最近的研究，如果露营地的空气质量好，答案是一个大大的“是”。

ex.s: Which camp will attract children who are interested in cooking?
ex.t: 哪个营地会吸引对烹饪感兴趣的孩子？

ex.s: While running every aspect of our own news station, kids and their fellow campers will create and host a broadcast airing each night at dinner for the entire camp.
ex.t: 在运营我们自己的新闻站的方方面面的同时，孩子们和营友将制作并主持每晚晚餐时播出的节目，面向整个营地。

defs.def: a place where young people go on holiday/vacation and take part in various activities or a particular activity 度假营

ex.s: Join us for TransForm, the interactive summer camp that helps you teens find your passion by participating in various activities and connecting with others.
ex.t: 加入我们的TransForm吧，这是一个互动夏令营，通过参与各种活动并与他人建立联系，帮助青少年找到自己的热情。

ex.s: Explorers Camp organizes engaging arts, history and science-related activities in every! class, and focuses on a range of topics that emphasize active learning, exploration and, most of all, fun!
ex.t: 探索者营在每一节课上都组织引人入胜的与艺术、历史、科学相关的活动，并聚焦于一系列强调主动学习、探索，尤其是乐趣的主题！

ex.s: All camp sessions are created with age-appropriate activities that are tailored to the multiple ways that kids learn.
ex.t: 所有营期都按年龄设计合适的活动，针对孩子多种学习方式量身定制。

ex.s: Families can enjoy the experience together, too, with Family Camp programs for families with children as young as 7.
ex.t: 家庭也能一起享受这种体验，因为有为7岁以下儿童家庭准备的"家庭营"项目。

defs.def: a place where people are kept in temporary buildings or tents, especially by a government and often for long periods 用于构成复合词

ex.s: There are birthday parties and summer camps as well.
ex.t: 还有生日派对和夏令营。

ex.s: From broadcasting to street art, these are just 4 of the 17 highly unique camps being offered.
ex.t: 从广播到街头艺术，这些只是所开设的17个极具特色的营会中的4个。

defs.def: a place where soldiers live while they are training or fighting 兵营
a group of people who have the same ideas about sth and oppose people with other ideas 阵营（指观点相同且与持不同观点者对立的集团）

ex.s: How are campers divided into different groups?
ex.t: 营员是如何被分成不同小组的？

ex.s: Campers who sign up for the 2-week secret agent camp can get to know about the life of real secret agents by learning strategies and military skills on the paintball field.
ex.t: 报名两周秘密特工营的营员，可以通过在彩弹场上学习策略与军事技能，了解真实特工的生活。

ex.s: Campers enjoy a staff-to-child ratio ranging from 1:4 to 1:7 depending on the age group.
ex.t: 营员享受的员工与儿童比例在1:4到1:7之间，取决于年龄组。

ex.s: When the ice did begin to melt, it started to destroy the ship, leaving the men with no other choice but to set up camp on the ice.
ex.t: 当冰真的开始融化时，它开始摧毁船只，使众人别无选择，只能在冰上扎营。

ex.s: Campers have a three-hour morning class engaging with a morning theme (9am to 12 noon) and a one-hour lunch break, followed by another three-hour class engaging with an afternoon theme (1pm to 4pm).
ex.t: 营员有一个三小时的上午课程（围绕上午主题，早9点至中午12点）和一个一小时的午休，之后是另一个三小时的下午课程（围绕下午主题，下午1点至4点）。

defs.def: one of the sides in a competition and the people connected with it 阵营（比赛的一方及其支持者）

ex.s: We shared the brief that if you’re fortunate enough to have success, you should put something back — he with his Newman’s Own food and his Hole in the Wall camps for kids who are seriously ill, and me with Sundance and the institute and the festival.
ex.t: 我们有着共同的信念：如果你有幸获得成功，就应该回馈社会——他通过纽曼自有食品和为重病儿童举办的"墙上的洞"夏令营，而我则通过圣丹斯电影节及其研究所和艺术节。

ex.s: We shared the brief that if you’re fortunate enough to have success, you should put something back - he with his Newman’s Own food and his Hole in the Wall camps for kids who are seriously ill, and me with Sundance and the institute and the festival.
ex.t: 我们有着共同的信念：如果你有幸获得成功，就应该回馈社会——他通过他的Newman's Own食品品牌和为重病儿童创办的Hole in the Wall夏令营来回报，而我则通过圣丹斯及其协会和电影节来回报。

defs.def: to put up a tent and live in it for a short time 宿营；露营

ex.s: My husband, our children and I have had wonderful camping experiences over the past ten years.
ex.t: 我的丈夫、我们的孩子和我过去十年中有过美好的露营经历。

ex.s: If anyone had told me three years ago that I would be spending most of my weekends camping.
ex.t: 如果三年前有人告诉我，我会把大部分周末花在露营上。

ex.s: The friends who introduced me to camping thought that it meant to be a pioneer.
ex.t: 那些把我带进露营圈的朋友以为，露营意味着要当个拓荒者。

ex.s: 38    Instead, we had a pop-up camper with comfortable beds and an air conditioner.
ex.t: 38    相反，我们有了一辆带有舒适床铺和空调的折叠式房车。

ex.s: I was to learn a lot about camping since then, however.
ex.t: 不过，从那以后我学到了很多关于露营的东西。

ex.s: I must say that I have certainly come to enjoy camping.
ex.t: 我必须说我确实已经开始喜欢露营了。

ex.s: After the trip, my family became quite interested in camping.
ex.t: 这次旅行之后，我的家人对露营产生了浓厚的兴趣。

ex.s: Campers, in my eyes, were people who enjoyed insect bites, ill-cooked meals, and uncomfortable sleeping bags.
ex.t: 在我眼中，露营者是那些喜欢蚊虫叮咬、半生不熟的食物和不舒服睡袋的人。

ex.s: Which activity will you choose if you want to go camping?
ex.t: 如果你想露营，会选哪项活动？

ex.s: Finally, the moment of our departure arrived, and we loaded suitcases, books, games, camping equipment, and a tent into the car and bravely drove off.
ex.t: 终于，我们出发的时刻到了，我们把行李箱、书、游戏、露营装备和帐篷装上车，勇敢地开车出发了。

ex.s: Mum, Dad and I went camping in Beidaihe.
ex.t: 妈妈、爸爸和我在北戴河露营了。

ex.s: They come to camp, wanting to know what it is like to be an astronaut or a pilot, and they leave with real-world applications for what they’re studying in the classroom.
ex.t: 他们来露营，想知道当宇航员或飞行员是什么感觉，离开时带着把课堂所学用于现实世界的实际办法。

to live in sb's house for a short time, especially when you do not have a bed there 借住；借宿；暂住

ex.s: Campers learn technical skills of roasting, frying and cutting, as well as some recipes that they can take home and share with their families.
ex.t: 营员们学习烘烤、煎炸和切割等技术技能，以及一些可以带回家与家人分享的食谱。
